key.name: update-interval-seconds
key.description: Number of seconds between usage refreshes.

key.name: display-mode
key.description: Choose whether the extension shows remaining quota ('left'), consumed quota ('used'), or percentage ('percent').

key.name: bar-display-mode
key.description: Show all enabled assistants ('all') or cycle through them with a click ('cycle').

key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: List of enabled AI coding assistant providers.

key.name: icon-style
key.description: Icon theme appearance: 'symbolic' (monochrome white) or 'color' (vibrant brand colors).

key.name: claude-token
key.description: Optional custom Anthropic OAuth or API token.
